concept.reason: Direct reference imagery and taxon-specific sources sufficient for original silhouette; no extra concept image.

scope: Original living reconstruction of Herrerasaurus ischigualastensis guided by Field Museum mounted skeleton photograph; not an exact catalogue specimen scan.

scientific_limits.en: Skin, color and soft tissues are inferred. Mounted skeleton may contain restored parts; photographic perspective is not calibrated anatomy. Taxonomic placement beyond named herrerasaurid is not settled here.
scientific_limits.zh: 皮肤、颜色和软组织为推断；展示骨架可能含修补，透视照片不是校准测量。本件不裁定该类更细系统位置。

scale.basis: 3m approximate NHM profile; width/height artistic estimates, not specimen measurements.

pose: Balanced biped, deep hip/pelvic body visible, modestly flexed compact neck, strong hands extended slightly ahead and clear of torso, palms inward; tail off ground.
shape_requirements: Preserve deep pelvis, strong grasping hands and relatively compact neck together; no Coelophysis long-neck slender-hand substitution.
Deep hip mass and substantial hindlimbs with readable hip/knee/ankle joints; tail smoothly tapers as counterbalance.
Grasping hands are a visible feature, not tiny tyrannosaur stubs. Three prominent clawed fingers plus reduced outer digits interpreted cautiously; no human-pronated palms.
Elongate toothed skull with moderate muzzle, not a bulky tyrannosaur head; living surface must cover bony fenestrae.
Profile/loft torso, neck and thighs; deliberate negative spaces; no untouched primitive chain.

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: deep pelvis, strong grasping hands and a relatively compact neck. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：较深骨盆、有力抓握手与相对紧凑的颈部。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block deep pelvis, strong grasping hands and a relatively compact neck with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织较深骨盆、有力抓握手与相对紧凑的颈部；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded
gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
